title: Addressing Biases in the Texts using an End-to-End Pipeline Approach
findings: The paper's proposed pipeline for bias detection and mitigation includes 'religion' as a category of bias, but no specific quantitative findings for religious groups are presented. The overall model was shown to be effective for the general task of identifying and mitigating bias.

measurement_description: The paper proposes a pipeline to detect, identify, and mitigate bias in text. Religion is one of the identity categories considered, where the goal is to identify and replace toxic, bias-bearing words related to religious identity.
